Latin.reason: Latin refers to Latin characters (script) used in the filtering criteria, not the Latin language

Arabic.reason: Arabic refers to Arabic script characters in the filtering criteria, not the Arabic language

Urdu.reason: Urdu refers to the target human language for which models are trained, evaluated, and resources are built throughout the paper

Persian.reason: Persian is mentioned only as part of the historical writing tradition of Urdu, not as a language under study

Portuguese.reason: Portuguese is mentioned only as an example of prior RoBERTa work in Portuguese NLP, not a focus of this work

Turkish.reason: Turkish is mentioned only in comparison to a prior Turkish study (SindBERT), not a language studied here

English.reason: English is mentioned only as a high-resource language for comparison, not a language studied in this work
